register.labelZh: FILL 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: fill in for somebody 可以表示某人暫時代替另一個人工作;fill somebody in 則可以表示把某人錯過的資料告訴他。；你可以 fill in a form,表示填寫表格;也可以 fill out a short story,表示加入有用細節,使故事更完整。；談論正餐、小食或某人是否已吃飽時,可以使用 fill somebody up。；FILL 片語動詞可以描述人或動物變得豐滿、地方坐滿了人,或容器被裝滿。
register.summaryEn: Fill in for somebody lets you explain that one person is temporarily doing another person’s job. Fill somebody in lets you give someone information they have missed. You can fill in a form or fill out a short story by adding useful details. Fill somebody up is useful when discussing meals, snacks and whether someone has eaten enough. The FILL family can describe a person or animal becoming fuller, a place becoming crowded, or a container being made full.
